title: Verify successful login with valid credentials
precondition: User is on the login page
steps:
1. Enter username
2. Enter password
3. Click Login button
expected_result: User is redirected to Products page, inventory items are displayed

title: Verify login denied for locked out user
precondition: User is on the login page
steps:
1. Enter username for locked out user
2. Enter password
3. Click Login button
expected_result: Error message displayed: Sorry, this user has been locked out.

title: Verify login fails with invalid username
precondition: User is on the login page
steps:
1. Enter invalid username
2. Enter valid password
3. Click Login button
expected_result: Error message: Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service

title: Verify login fails with invalid password
precondition: User is on the login page
steps:
1. Enter valid username
2. Enter invalid password
3. Click Login button
expected_result: Error message: Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service

title: Verify user can add item to cart
precondition: User is logged in and on Products page
steps:
1. Click on Add to Cart button for Backpack
2. Verify item is added
expected_result: Item is added to cart, cart count increments to 1

title: Verify user can remove item from cart
steps:
1. Click on Remove button for item
2. Verify item is removed
expected_result: Item is removed, cart count decrements
